title: The Global T20 Nomad: KA Pollard's Journey Across 9 Leagues
summary: KA Pollard has played in 9 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL), scoring 11702 runs at 30.3.
body:
## 9 Leagues, One Mission

KA Pollard is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **9 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL, MLC, PSL, SA20, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 11702 runs | 534 innings | Avg 30.3 | SR 149.4

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Pollard has delivered across all of them.

---
*Data across 9 T20 leagues. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
